Vadim Gordeev is a Barcelona-based performance artist, engineer, and illusion designer who transforms simple mechanical systems into mesmerizing living sculptures. Blending engineering, kinetic art, magic, and performance, he creates poetic illusions where everyday objects appear to move, breathe, and defy logic. Alfie Dwyer, working as ze.zima, is an interdisciplinary artist creating strange kinetic objects where mechanical systems collide with fragmented images. In Secret Programs, printed fragments ,mounted onto moving PLA components, driven by a gear motor and a modified Geneva mechanism. As the mechanism turns, the image is continuously broken apart and reconstructed  becoming something between an image, a machine. #art #artist #avantgarde #niche #weird
